messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: high gateway 5xx rate detected on cluster gateway-prod (us-west-2). rolling 1m 5xx rate = 3.6% (threshold 1%). AlertID: GW-5XX-2423456789. Link: https://grafana.internal/gateway-prod/alerts/2423456789

maya: oncall here, ack'ing. paging policy -> primary oncall. jumping into metrics now.

diego: I see the error spike, looks like 502/504s from upstream-model-proxy, lots of timeouts in the last 90s.

maya: @dieg o can you paste the query?

diego: sure — prometheus query I ran: 
```
(sum(rate(gateway_requests_total{code=~"5..",env="prod"}[1m])) by (region) / sum(rate(gateway_requests_total{env="prod"}[1m])) by (region)) * 100
```
results: us-west-2 ~3.6%, eu-west-1 ~0.2

linh: seeing retries ramping too, upstream timeout set to 3s on model-proxy. Many requests are hitting the proxy queue and returning 504.

samir: are backend pods healthy? kube shows model-proxy pods at 95% CPU, but not OOM. No recent deploys in the last hour.

jordan: ops-bot visible: Cloud provider reported increased network errors in us-west-2 between 12:03-12:06 — sounds correlated.

maya: ok first step: mitigate customer impact. Options: 1) enable local caching for frequent prompts (short-term), 2) increase upstream timeout and retry/backoff, 3) route traffic away from the affected AZs/instances. Thoughts?

diego: increasing timeout to 6s could reduce 504s but may increase latency. Prefer routing fallback: set routing policy to prefer provider B (model-host-b) for latency-insensitive calls (embeddings batch jobs) and keep provider A (model-host-a) for low-latency real-time. But we need quick change.

linh: I can flip a routing rule to reduce traffic to model-host-a by 60% for the next 15m. Doing a canary shift: 40% -> model-host-a, 60% -> model-host-b. Will monitor.

maya: please do that and post the rollout command.

linh: running: 
```
redwoodctl route update --cluster gateway-prod --selector model-host-a --weight 40 --timeout 6s --expires 15m
```
applied.

incident-bot: Route update noted by linch. ChangeID: ROUTE-2423456795.

samir: after the shift 5xx dropped to 0.9% in ~35s, latency remains slightly higher but errors are down. Good signal.

maya: nice. I'm going to silence the immediate page noise: temporarily mute GW-5XX-2423456789 alert on paging for 10m (we'll still log).

maya: doing mute: `ops-bot silence alert GW-5XX-2423456789 for 10m`
ops-bot: Alert GW-5XX-2423456789 silenced until +10m.

diego: we should also add a short suppress window to the alert rule so short spikes don't page. Current rule pages on 1m window >1%. We should change to 3 consecutive 1m windows (3m) and add a suppression for known flapping upstreams.

linh: agreed. I'll prepare a temp rule update after this is stable.

jordan: customer impact: I pulled transaction logs; ~2% of requests in us-west-2 returned 5xx and roughly 0.5% were user-visible failures (retry recovered others). I'll start a quick customer-impact note for CS.

maya: thanks. Who's taking the handoff in 20m? I have another meeting at +30m.

linh: I can take the handoff.

maya: ok @linh you're on for next 2 hours. I'm documenting current mitigations in thread.

--- 20m later ---

linh: route change holding, 5xx steady ~0.7% (under paging threshold). I'm going to create a follow-up ticket to tune alerts and update runbook.

diego: draft alert change proposal (to discuss):
- Old: page if 5xx rate > 1% over 1m
- New: page if 5xx rate > 1% over 3m AND absolute 5xx count > 200 (to avoid pages from tiny traffic spikes)
- Add grouping by region and add suppression window for known provider flaps (5m)
- Add a derived metric: gateway_upstream_5xx_ratio{provider} to better pinpoint provider-induced errors

linh: +1. Also propose a non-paging warning banner for 1m spikes (for dashboard only).

samir: please include a Grafana panel change: add a stacked 5xx by provider and a rate per AZ. Also add an annotation when routing changes occur for easier post-incident correlation.

maya: (from earlier meeting) noted. Also add a gentle circuit-breaker in the gateway: if upstream provider 5xx rate > 5% for 2m, start dropping non-essential requests and route to degraded experience path. This will be in the runbook as a manual step for now.

linh: creating ticket SRE-3456: "Alert tuning + dashboard + runbook updates for gateway 5xx spikes". Assigning to diego, linch, samir. Estimated: 2 days.

diego: writing quick prometheus rule snippet for the new alert: 
```
- alert: GatewayHigh5xxSustained
  expr: (sum(rate(gateway_requests_total{code=~"5..",env="prod"}[3m])) / sum(rate(gateway_requests_total{env="prod"}[3m]))) > 0.01
  for: 3m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    runbook: https://wiki.internal/runbooks/gateway-5xx
```

maya: good. Make sure the rule also has `min_samples` style guard (absolute count > 200) — we can implement by multiplying by total requests or using `sum(rate(...)[3m]) > 200` as an additional condition.

diego: updated snippet with absolute guard: 
```
expr: (sum(rate(gateway_requests_total{code=~"5..",env="prod"}[3m])) > 200) and ((sum(rate(gateway_requests_total{code=~"5..",env="prod"}[3m])) / sum(rate(gateway_requests_total{env="prod"}[3m]))) > 0.01)
```

linh: adding grafana panel request: "gateway - 5xx by provider" with annotations for Route changes and Cloud provider incidents. Opening PR against infra-dashboards.

samir: after-action: add the following to runbook: 
- triage steps to quickly decide routing vs timeout tuning
- CLI commands: `redwoodctl route update ...` and rollback steps
- who to page for provider-level issues (network, infra)

jordan: CS update: sent note to CS and Support: subject "Transient gateway errors in US-WEST-2 - limited impact". Included impacted percentage and timeframe.

maya: final checks: confirm all mitigations are in prod and stable. linch confirm?

linh: confirmed. Route change expires automatically in 15m but I'll extend if spike returns. 5xx at 0.6% currently.

maya: thanks team. I'll close the page and convert this to an incident review doc later. Quick action items before I leave the handoff:
- SRE-3456 created with owners (diego, linh, samir)
- Prometheus rule change PR (diego)
- Grafana panels PR (linh)
- Runbook update (samir)
- CS post done (jordan)

linh: adding note to the ticket: include runbook step to mute paging for 10m during mitigations to avoid oncall churn.

maya: handing off. @linh you're main oncall now. I'll be reachable via DM for 30m.

incident-bot: Incident GW-5XX-2423456789 transitioned to post-incident (status: mitigated).

linh: filing post-incident quick notes in the incident tracker now. Will schedule a 30m blameless review tomorrow for alert tuning.

samir: one more: we should add a heartbeat monitor between gateway and providers so we can detect provider flaps before customer-facing 5xx rise. Adding to SRE-3456.

maya: ack. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
